note: XVIII establishing, far and window shots (Ian, 17 Nov: Google does the establishing work).
style: A cinematic Romantic oil painting of 1893 in the manner of the reference: academic realism, atmospheric haze, cool blue dusk and moonlight against warm amber lamplight, a wide establishing view, rich painterly brushwork. One single painting filling the whole 16:9 frame, no text, signature, border or black bars.

beats.text: Exterior, the asylum at Purfleet at five o'clock on a late-September afternoon, 1893: low golden sun across the lawn, long shadows of elms, a hansom cab standing at the porch, rooks over the chimneys. Any people are small and far off, with no detail in their faces.

Exterior at dusk: a barred ground-floor window of the asylum seen from the garden, a lamp inside showing a bare whitewashed cell and two small figures, flies against the glass, ivy around the bars. Any people are small and far off, with no detail in their faces.

A long whitewashed asylum corridor in 1893, seen from one end: a row of heavy cell doors with iron grilles, gas jets, an attendant small in the distance, cold evening light from high windows. Any people are small and far off, with no detail in their faces.

Exterior, a small country railway station on the Thames marshes at evening, 1893: a steam train standing at the low platform, a single lamp, a waiting dog-cart in the yard, wide flat sky. Any people are small and far off, with no detail in their faces.

Exterior at dusk: a dog-cart with two small figures driving along a hedged Essex lane toward the dark trees and lit windows of the asylum, autumn fields, a pale evening sky. Any people are small and far off, with no detail in their faces.

Exterior at dusk, looking in from the lawn at the tall lit windows of the asylum drawing-room: an elderly man bowing to a young woman inside, small, the house dark above, the sky deep blue. Any people are small and far off, with no detail in their faces.

Exterior at night, looking in from the dark garden at the lit study window of the asylum: six small figures seated round a table in lamplight, papers spread, the rest of the house dark, the moon rising behind the chimneys. Any people are small and far off, with no detail in their faces.
Exterior at night: a full moon above the gabled roof and chapel of the old house Carfax, black trees, mist lying on the ground beyond the high wall, a bat crossing the moon.
Exterior at night: a marble statue in the asylum garden, moonlit and pale against black yews, fallen leaves on the gravel walk. No people.
Close view: a golden crucifix lying on a dark polished table among papers and an oil lamp, in deep shadow, 1893. No people.
Exterior at night: a high view over the moonlit slate roofs and chimney stacks of the asylum, the dark mass of Carfax beyond the wall, mist on the Thames marshes to the horizon.

Exterior at night: the lit study window of the asylum seen from the dark lawn, a great bat clinging to the outside of the sill against the glowing glass; a man small in the shadow of the shrubbery below, watching. Any people are small and far off, with no detail in their faces.
Exterior at night: a dark wood beyond the asylum wall, bare trees against a moonlit sky, a single bat flying off over the treetops.

Exterior at night: the dark front of the asylum with one small upstairs window lit, a woman's silhouette at the curtain, the moon behind thin cloud, black elms. Any people are small and far off, with no detail in their faces.

A dark asylum passage at four in the morning, 1893: four small figures with a lantern going away down the long corridor, their shadows thrown along the walls. Any people are small and far off, with no detail in their faces.

Exterior at four in the morning: the asylum under a sinking moon, every window dark but one barred window on the ground floor glowing, mist on the lawn. Any people are small and far off, with no detail in their faces.

Exterior at night, looking in through the bars of a lit cell window: a man standing and pleading with his hands raised before a group of four men, small, lamplight on whitewashed walls. Any people are small and far off, with no detail in their faces.
Close view: the iron grille of a cell door in an asylum corridor at night, lamplight and shadows falling through it onto the stone floor. No people.
Exterior at night: the high old wall between the asylum and Carfax, moonlight on the wet bricks, the dark chapel roof beyond, an owl on the coping.

Exterior before dawn: the asylum and its grounds under a cold grey-blue sky, the first faint light behind the chimneys, the statue and hedges in silhouette, mist on the lawn. Any people are small and far off, with no detail in their faces.

An asylum corridor at night seen from inside a doorway: lamplight from a cell spilling across the floor, four small figures standing at the threshold, the passage beyond in darkness. Any people are small and far off, with no detail in their faces.
